tone_read: Educational and calm: strength, ingredients, how to apply and who it suits, with no fear, hype or result promises.
language_read: "10% Niacinamide" is in house format, and Matmarine, Zinc and Acetyl Glucosamine are named without strengths because the page gives none. "No sticky residue" is an unscoped feel claim taken from the page (F8); a reviewer may prefer it scoped to "on application".
